wizard#/cards/17.name: Counterspell
wizard#/cards/17.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
wizard#/cards/17.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

wizard#/cards/29.name: Counterpulse
wizard#/cards/29.rangeAndTarget: Caster whose spell you successfully Counterspelled
wizard#/cards/29.duration: Until end of target's next turn
wizard#/cards/29.effect: Counterpulse. Tags: hero, spellbinder, counter, control. Immediately after your Counterspell succeeds, spend 1 RP. The countered caster is Silenced until the end of its next turn. This is part of the successful counter event rather than another spell cast and cannot trigger another Counterpulse.

source.originalText: Counterpulse: Countering a spell silences the caster for 1 round

wizard#/cards/60.name: Arcane Feedback
wizard#/cards/60.effect: Source progression line 5191, converted from historical slot wording to RP. After your Counterspell successfully negates a spell, restore 1 RP, never above your normal maximum. A counter produced by a companion, reflected spell or copied Counterspell does not trigger this feature.
